nodes.text:
The Cinderwaste. Two thirty-five at the gate, two fifty-five at the throne, and nothing in there is having a good day.

This is the last road. There isn't another one after it.

The Ashen Throne, and the First Flame beside it. They are the top of the world and they are not subtle about it.

Bring three friends. I will not soften that.

From the Reach, when it stops paying - same as the marsh stopped paying before it.

The gap is bigger this time. A hundred and twenty to two thirty-five, and nothing between. Everyone crossing it does so on the last road's wages.
